title: Anhydrous
summary: ANHY'DROUS, adjective [Gr. dry, and water.] Destitute of water. Anhydrite is so called, because it is destitute of the water of crystallization.

inlines.v: ANHY'DROUS, adjective [Gr. dry, and water.] Destitute of water. Anhydrite is so called, because it is destitute of the water of crystallization.
